# Spec reference

Generated from the Go structs by `make schema`; the JSON Schema is [`hikyaku.schema.json`](https://xavidop.github.io/hikyaku/schema/hikyaku.schema.json).
Point your editor at it with `# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://xavidop.github.io/hikyaku/schema/hikyaku.schema.json`.

Durations read like `500ms`, `30s`, `5m`, `1h`, `7d`; sizes like `512`, `8KiB`, `10MB`. `{{secrets.NAME}}` and `{{env.NAME}}` are replaced when the spec loads; `{{ .json.x }}` templates run per message.

## Top level (`hikyaku.yaml`)

| Key | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `version` **(required)** | integer | Spec format version. Always 1. One of `1`. |
| `name` **(required)** | string | Relay name. Used in metrics, logs and the shared-state keys. |
| `secrets` | map of string | Secrets by name, each a mamori ref (env:NAME, file:///path, vault://..., or a comma-separated chain tried in order, such as env:A,file:///run/a). Reference one as {{secrets.NAME}}. |
| `genkit` | [Genkit](#genkit) | Genkit plugins for the AI router. |
| `models` | [Models](#models) | Default models, model retries and model fallback chains. |
| `defaults` | [Policy](#policy) | Delivery policy inherited by every destination (each field on its own). |
| `sources` **(required)** | [Source](#source)[] | Where messages come from. |
| `destinations` **(required)** | [Destination](#destination)[] | Where messages go. |
| `stores` | [Store](#store)[] | Shared-state backends (history, decision cache, dedupe, idempotency, budgets), referenced by name. The first one is the default store; with none, an in-process memory store is used. |
| `dead_letter` | [DeadLetter](#deadletter) | Where a message goes when a required destination and all its fallbacks failed. Defaults to stderr. |
| `routes` **(required)** | [Route](#route)[] | Which destinations get the messages of which sources. |
| `server` | [Server](#server) | Admin API, workers and shutdown. |
| `observability` | [Observability](#observability) | Logs, OpenTelemetry traces and Prometheus metrics. |
| `buffer` | [Buffer](#buffer) | The queue between sources and delivery workers. |
| `egress` | [Egress](#egress) | SSRF guard for destinations whose URL host is a per-message template. |
| `plugins` | [PluginBinary](#pluginbinary)[] | Out-of-process plugins: binaries hikyaku starts and talks gRPC to. Each one adds the source and destination types it declares. |

## `Source`

| Key | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `name` **(required)** | string | Unique source name. |
| `type` **(required)** | string | Protocol: http, https, ws, wss, sse, stdin, file (M1); see the protocol matrix for the rest. |
| `mode` | string | listen (hikyaku is the server), poll (pull on a schedule) or subscribe (long-lived client). Defaults per protocol. One of `listen`, `poll`, `subscribe`. |
| `listen` | string | listen: address, such as :8080. |
| `path` | string | listen: request path (default /); file: the file to read. |
| `methods` | string[] | http listen: accepted methods (default POST, PUT). |
| `tls` | [TLS](#tls) | TLS (and mTLS with client_ca_file) for listen, DTLS for udp; client TLS for poll and subscribe. |
| `auth` | [Auth](#auth) | Inbound authentication of listen sources. |
| `ack` | string | delivered (default) or accepted. http and grpc listen: delivered answers once the message is delivered or dead-lettered, accepted as soon as it is queued (on disk with a disk buffer). Subscribe sources: delivered acknowledges the broker once the outcome is final, accepted once the message is queued (safe with buffer.type: disk only). One of `delivered`, `accepted`. |
| `respond` | [Respond](#respond) | http and grpc listen: send a destination's reply back to the caller (smart reverse proxy; grpc maps it into the method's output type). |
| `max_body_bytes` | [Size](#size) | Largest accepted message (default 10MiB; grpc and openai 4MiB; tcp, udp and mqtt 1MiB). A listen source refuses a larger one (http 413, grpc RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED); a subscribe or poll source logs it and acknowledges it, so it cannot loop forever. |
| `url` | string | poll or subscribe: the endpoint. |
| `headers` | map of string | poll or subscribe: request headers. |
| `method` | string | poll: request method (default GET). |
| `body` | string | poll: request body. |
| `interval` | [Duration](#duration) | poll: time between polls (default 30s). |
| `timeout` | [Duration](#duration) | poll (http, s3, gcs): per-request timeout (default 10s). |
| `retry` | [Retry](#retry) | poll (http, s3): retries per poll before skipping to the next interval. gcs retries its reads itself. |
| `dedupe` | [Dedupe](#dedupe) | Drop messages whose key was seen within the ttl, on any source (poll dedupe, cross-replica idempotency). A duplicate is acked as filtered and counted in hikyaku_deduped_total. |
| `split` | string | poll: jq expression that splits one response into several messages, such as .items[]. s3, gcs: also lines, one message per non-empty line of an object (NDJSON). |
| `reconnect` | [Reconnect](#reconnect) | subscribe: reconnect policy. |
| `failover_urls` | string[] | subscribe (ws, wss, sse, grpc, nats, jetstream, mqtt, amqp, redis): URLs rotated through when the primary is down. |
| `format` | string | stdin and file: each line is a message body (default) or an envelope in wire form. One of `body`, `envelope`. |
| `follow` | boolean | file: keep reading lines appended to the file. |
| `brokers` | string[] | kafka: bootstrap brokers (host:port). |
| `topic` | string | kafka, mqtt: the topic (mqtt: a topic filter); eventhubs: the event hub; servicebus: the topic (with subscription). |
| `topics` | string[] | kafka, mqtt: several topics (mqtt: filters) instead of topic. |
| `group` | string | kafka, redis streams, eventhubs: consumer group; mqtt v5: shared subscription group ($share/<group>/<filter>). |
| `start` | string | Where a new consumer starts. kafka, redis streams, eventhubs: earliest or latest (default latest); jetstream: all, new (default) or last. One of `earliest`, `latest`, `all`, `new`, `last`. |
| `sasl` | [SASL](#sasl) | kafka: SASL authentication. |
| `username` | string | mqtt, nats, redis, amqp: user name (mqtt, amqp and redis also take it in the URL; this field wins). |
| `password` | string | mqtt, nats, redis, amqp: password; use {{secrets.X}}. |
| `token` | string | nats: authentication token; use {{secrets.X}}. |
| `creds_file` | string | nats: a .creds file (JWT and NKey seed). |
| `subject` | string | nats: subject (wildcards * and > allowed); jetstream: filter subject of the consumer. |
| `queue` | string | nats: queue group (members share the messages); amqp: the queue consumed; servicebus: the queue. |
| `prefetch` | integer | Messages a subscribe source keeps in flight: amqp prefetch, jetstream max_ack_pending, redis streams entries read and not acknowledged, kafka records buffered, mqtt v5 receive maximum, pubsub max outstanding, servicebus prefetch (default 64); nats: messages buffered before the client drops them (default 65536). sqs: messages per receive, 1 to 10 (default 10). |
| `ack_wait` | [Duration](#duration) | jetstream: redelivery delay of an unacknowledged message; redis streams: how long a pending entry stays idle before it is reclaimed and delivered again (default 30s for both). |
| `stream` | string | jetstream: the stream; redis: the stream key (XREADGROUP). |
| `consumer` | string | redis streams: this consumer's name in the group (default <host name>-<source name>); keep it stable, a restart resumes the entries it left pending. |
| `durable` | string | jetstream: durable consumer name, so a restart resumes where it stopped (default the source name). |
| `channel` | string | redis pub/sub: channel, or a pattern with * (PSUBSCRIBE). |
| `qos` | integer | mqtt: subscription QoS (default 1). One of `0`, `1`, `2`. |
| `client_id` | string | mqtt: client identifier, which keys a persistent session; kafka: client.id. Default hikyaku-<relay>-<source>. |
| `clean_session` | boolean | mqtt: start a clean session (default false: the broker keeps the session and queued QoS 1/2 messages across reconnects). |
| `protocol_version` | string | mqtt: protocol version (default 5). One of `3.1.1`, `5`. |
| `exchange` | string | amqp: exchange the queue is bound to (with routing_key). |
| `routing_key` | string | amqp: binding key of the queue on exchange. |
| `declare` | boolean | amqp: declare the queue (durable) and its binding when missing. |
| `descriptor_set` | string | grpc: a FileDescriptorSet file (protoc --descriptor_set_out --include_imports) describing the services. |
| `services` | string[] | grpc listen: the services of descriptor_set to serve (default all); hikyaku.relay.v1.Relay is always served. |
| `reflection` | boolean | grpc listen: serve the reflection service (default true); subscribe: resolve method through server reflection when there is no descriptor_set (default true). |
| `frame` | string | tcp, udp: framing. newline (default): one message per line; length: each message after a length_bytes big-endian length; raw: tcp, a connection's whole stream; udp, each datagram. One of `newline`, `length`, `raw`. |
| `length_bytes` | integer | tcp, udp: size of the length prefix with frame: length (default 4). One of `1`, `2`, `4`, `8`. |
| `queue_url` | string | sqs: the queue URL. sns, eventbridge: the SQS queue subscribed to the topic or rule. |
| `wait_time` | [Duration](#duration) | sqs: long-poll wait (default 20s, at most 20s). |
| `visibility_timeout` | [Duration](#duration) | sqs: how long a received message stays hidden (default the queue's). |
| `bucket` | string | s3, gcs: the bucket polled. |
| `prefix` | string | s3, gcs: only objects under this prefix. |
| `after` | string | s3, gcs: what happens to an object once its messages are final: keep (remembered in state_store), delete (default) or move (to move_to). One of `keep`, `delete`, `move`. |
| `move_to` | string | s3, gcs: prefix objects are moved under with after: move. |
| `state_store` | string | Store (by name) that keeps a source's progress: eventhubs checkpoints, s3/gcs objects already read with after: keep. Default the first store. |
| `subscription` | string | pubsub: the subscription; servicebus: the topic subscription. |
| `aws` | [AWS](#aws) | sqs, sns, eventbridge, s3: AWS region and credentials (default the SDK's chain). |
| `gcp` | [GCP](#gcp) | pubsub, gcs: project and credentials (default Application Default Credentials). |
| `azure` | [Azure](#azure) | servicebus, eventhubs: connection string or namespace and credentials. |
| `models` | string[] | openai: the model names /v1/models lists and clients may ask for (default [hikyaku]); route on msg.json.model. |
| `ordering` | [Ordering](#ordering) | Deliver messages with the same key one at a time, in arrival order. |
| `options` | object | Settings of a plugin type (a source registered by a custom build); the plugin decodes and validates them. |

## `Destination`

| Key | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `name` **(required)** | string | Unique destination name. |
| `type` **(required)** | string | Protocol: http, https, ws, wss, sse, stdout, stderr, file, fault, group, grpc, tcp, udp, kafka, nats, jetstream, mqtt, amqp, redis, sqs, sns, eventbridge, s3, pubsub, gcs, servicebus, eventhubs, model, or a plugin's type. |
| `url` | string | http/ws: target URL, which may contain per-message templates (hosts are checked against egress). grpc: grpc://host:port or grpcs://; tcp: tcp://host:port or tls://; udp: udp://host:port or dtls://; nats, mqtt, amqp, redis: the server URL. |
| `method` | string | http: method (default POST); grpc: full method name, /package.Service/Method. |
| `headers` | map of string | Headers set on every request; values may be per-message templates. |
| `body` | string | Per-message template of the outgoing body (default: the message body). |
| `tls` | [TLS](#tls) | Client TLS, DTLS for udp (mTLS with cert_file and key_file). |
| `sign` | [Sign](#sign) | http: sign every request with an HMAC of its body, so the receiver can check who sent it. |
| `path` | string | file: the file appended to; sse: the stream path (default /). |
| `listen` | string | sse: address the event stream is served on. |
| `format` | string | file/stdout/stderr: write each message as an envelope line (default) or its body. One of `envelope`, `body`. |
| `frame` | string | ws: frame type, text (default) or binary. tcp, udp: framing, newline (default), length (a length_bytes big-endian prefix) or raw. One of `text`, `binary`, `newline`, `length`, `raw`. |
| `event` | string | sse: per-message template of the event name. |
| `replay` | integer | sse: events kept for Last-Event-ID resume (default 1000). |
| `auth` | [Auth](#auth) | sse: authentication of the clients that read the stream: bearer, api_key, jwt, ip_allow (401 on failure; hmac does not apply). |
| `fault` | [Fault](#fault) | fault: the faults injected (local testing and the resilience suite). |
| `brokers` | string[] | kafka: bootstrap brokers (host:port). |
| `topic` | string | Per-message template of the topic. kafka, mqtt, pubsub: the topic; sns: the topic ARN; eventhubs: the event hub; servicebus: the topic. |
| `key` | string | Per-message template of the message key. kafka: record key (partitioning); pubsub: ordering key; eventhubs: partition key; s3, gcs: object key (default <relay>/<date>/<id>.json, or .ndjson for a batch). |
| `sasl` | [SASL](#sasl) | kafka: SASL authentication. |
| `username` | string | mqtt, nats, redis, amqp: user name. |
| `password` | string | mqtt, nats, redis, amqp: password; use {{secrets.X}}. |
| `token` | string | nats: authentication token; use {{secrets.X}}. |
| `creds_file` | string | nats: a .creds file (JWT and NKey seed). |
| `subject` | string | Per-message template of the subject. nats, jetstream: the subject published to; sns: the message subject. |
| `acks` | string | kafka: acknowledgements a produce waits for (default all, with the idempotent producer). One of `all`, `leader`, `none`. |
| `compression` | string | kafka: batch compression (default none). One of `none`, `gzip`, `snappy`, `lz4`, `zstd`. |
| `qos` | integer | mqtt: publish QoS (default 1). One of `0`, `1`, `2`. |
| `retain` | boolean | mqtt: publish retained messages. |
| `client_id` | string | mqtt: client identifier; kafka: client.id. Default hikyaku-<relay>-<destination>. |
| `protocol_version` | string | mqtt: protocol version (default 5). One of `3.1.1`, `5`. |
| `exchange` | string | amqp: exchange published to (default the default exchange, which routes by queue name). |
| `routing_key` | string | amqp: per-message template of the routing key. |
| `persistent` | boolean | amqp: persistent delivery mode (default true). |
| `mandatory` | boolean | amqp: fail a message no queue is bound to receive (a permanent error) instead of dropping it. |
| `declare` | boolean | amqp: declare the exchange (topic, durable) when missing. |
| `stream` | string | redis: stream key appended to (XADD); jetstream: the stream a publish must land in (an expected-stream check). |
| `channel` | string | redis: pub/sub channel published to; a per-message template. |
| `max_len` | integer | redis streams: approximate length the stream is trimmed to (MAXLEN ~). |
| `descriptor_set` | string | grpc: a FileDescriptorSet file describing method's service. |
| `reflection` | boolean | grpc: resolve method through server reflection when there is no descriptor_set (default true). |
| `length_bytes` | integer | tcp, udp: size of the length prefix with frame: length (default 4). One of `1`, `2`, `4`, `8`. |
| `queue_url` | string | sqs: the queue URL. |
| `group_id` | string | Per-message template of the ordering group. sqs, sns FIFO: message group ID; servicebus: session ID. |
| `delay` | [Duration](#duration) | sqs: delivery delay (at most 15m). |
| `event_bus` | string | eventbridge: event bus name or ARN (default the account's default bus). |
| `event_source` | string | eventbridge: the events' source field (default hikyaku.<relay>). |
| `detail_type` | string | eventbridge: per-message template of the detail-type (default the message subject, else hikyaku.message). |
| `bucket` | string | s3, gcs: the bucket written to. |
| `content_type` | string | s3, gcs: the objects' content type (default the message's). |
| `queue` | string | servicebus: the queue (or topic). |
| `aws` | [AWS](#aws) | sqs, sns, eventbridge, s3: AWS region and credentials (default the SDK's chain). |
| `gcp` | [GCP](#gcp) | pubsub, gcs: project and credentials (default Application Default Credentials). |
| `azure` | [Azure](#azure) | servicebus, eventhubs: connection string or namespace and credentials. |
| `model` | string | model: the Genkit model that answers, provider/name (googleai/gemini-2.5-flash, openai/gpt-4o-mini, openrouter/anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.5, ollama/llama3.2). |
| `generation` | [Generation](#generation) | model: generation settings applied when the request does not set them. |
| `options` | object | Settings of a plugin type (a destination registered by a custom build); the plugin decodes and validates them. |
| `timeout` | [Duration](#duration) | Per-attempt timeout (default 5s). |
| `deadline` | [Duration](#duration) | Overall budget across attempts and fallbacks (default none). |
| `retry` | [Retry](#retry) | Retry policy per endpoint. |
| `circuit_breaker` | [CircuitBreaker](#circuitbreaker) | Circuit breaker per endpoint. |
| `retry_budget` | [RetryBudget](#retrybudget) | Caps retries as a fraction of traffic. |
| `fallback` | string[] | Destinations tried in order after this one exhausts its retries, fails permanently, has its breaker open, its budget spent or its deadline hit. |
| `required` | boolean | A required destination (default) must succeed, on its primary or a fallback, before the message is acked; a failure goes to the DLQ. A best-effort one is counted and logged. |
| `idempotent` | boolean | The endpoint dedupes by idempotency key; required for hedging. |
| `idempotency_header` | string | Header carrying the idempotency key (default Idempotency-Key). |
| `transforms` | [Transform](#transform)[] | Transforms applied before delivering here. |
| `strategy` | string | group: how members are picked (default failover). One of `failover`, `round_robin`, `weighted`, `least_latency`. |
| `members` | [Member](#member)[] | group: the endpoints. |
| `health_check` | [HealthCheck](#healthcheck) | group: active health checks; unhealthy members are skipped until they recover. |
| `hedge` | [Hedge](#hedge) | group: race another member when the first is slow (idempotent destinations only). |
| `deliver_after` | [Duration](#duration) | Hold each message of a route this long before delivering it here, counted from when it was received. |
| `deliver_at` | string | Per-message template of the time to deliver at, in RFC 3339 (2026-12-24T09:00:00Z). A message it renders empty for follows deliver_after, or goes at once. |
| `rate_limit` | [RateLimit](#ratelimit) | Send at most this many requests per second; the others wait their turn. |
| `batch` | [Batch](#batch) | Deliver messages in batches: one request (one Kafka produce, one SQS SendMessageBatch, one S3 object, one HTTP body) per batch. |

## `Retry`

| Key | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `attempts` | integer | Tries per endpoint; 1 means no retry (default 5). |
| `backoff` | [Duration](#duration) | Base wait, doubled per try (default 200ms). |
| `max_backoff` | [Duration](#duration) | Cap on the wait (default 10s). |
| `jitter` | string | full (default): random in [0, wait]; equal: wait/2 + random half; none. One of `full`, `equal`, `none`. |
| `retry_on` | [TagList](#taglist) | Error tags retried (default connect, timeout, 5xx, 429): ranges (5xx), codes (503), classes (connect, timeout) and protocol codes (ws:close_1011). |
| `never_on` | [TagList](#taglist) | Error tags never retried (default 4xx). A more specific retry_on tag wins, so 429 and 408 still retry. |
| `respect_retry_after` | boolean | Wait what Retry-After (or a broker hint) says, capped by max_backoff (default true). |

## `CircuitBreaker`

| Key | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | boolean | Default true. |
| `failure_ratio` | number | Open when failures/requests in the window reach this (default 0.5). |
| `min_requests` | integer | Requests in the window before the ratio counts (default 20). |
| `open_for` | [Duration](#duration) | How long the breaker stays open (default 30s). |
| `half_open_max` | integer | Trial requests while half-open (default 5). |
| `window` | [Duration](#duration) | Rolling window of the failure ratio (default 60s). |

## `RetryBudget`

| Key | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | boolean | Default true. |
| `ratio` | number | Retries allowed per first attempt in the window (default 0.2). |
| `min_per_second` | number | Retries always allowed per second (default 10). |
| `store` | string | Store that shares the counters across replicas (default: in-process). |

## `Route`

| Key | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `name` **(required)** | string | Unique route name. |
| `from` **(required)** | string[] | Source names. |
| `to` | string[] | Shortcut for a static router. |
| `filter` | string | CEL expression over msg; false skips the route. |
| `transforms` | [Transform](#transform)[] | Transforms applied before routing. |
| `router` | [RouterSpec](#routerspec) | The router; default static over to:. |

## `RouterSpec`

| Key | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `type` **(required)** | string | static, rules (CEL), ai, or sticky (last destinations of the history key). One of `static`, `rules`, `ai`, `sticky`. |
| `when` | string | CEL condition over msg: only the messages it is true for reach this router; the others skip it, with no call, and go to the next router of the fallback chain. On an ai router it keeps model spend to the messages that need a model, such as has(msg.json.text), msg.headers["X-Priority"] == "high" or msg.json.tier == "enterprise". A condition that cannot be evaluated (a missing field) counts as false. |
| `to` | string[] | static: destinations. |
| `rules` | [Rule](#rule)[] | rules: evaluated in order. |
| `match` | string | rules: first matching rule (default) or every match. One of `first`, `all`. |
| `default` | string[] | rules: destinations when no rule matches (else the router fails over). |
| `engine` | string | ai: decision (System One, default) or generative (GenerateData on any model). One of `decision`, `generative`. |
| `model` | string | ai: model (default models.decision or models.default). |
| `fallback_models` | string[] | ai: overrides the global model fallback chain. |
| `instructions` | string | ai: the system message, in front of every question. |
| `state` | string | ai: per-message template of what the model evaluates (default {{ .bodyText }}). |
| `state_json` | boolean | ai: the state is JSON (sent as an object). |
| `candidates` | [Candidate](#candidate)[] | ai: the destinations the model may pick, each with what it is for. |
| `multi` | boolean | ai: true asks one yes/no per candidate (in one request) and delivers to every one above min_confidence; false asks one choice. |
| `min_confidence` | number | ai: lowest probability accepted. |
| `min_margin` | number | ai, single choice: top minus second must exceed this. |
| `input` | [AIInput](#aiinput) | ai: how the state is built. |
| `timeout` | [Duration](#duration) | ai: budget of the whole AI step, model fallbacks included (default 10s). |
| `cache` | [Cache](#cache) | ai: decision cache. |
| `history` | [History](#history) | ai and sticky: route with past calls of a key. |
| `on_low_confidence` | string[] | ai: destinations when the model answered but was not sure. |
| `fallback_on_low_confidence` | boolean | ai: hand low-confidence answers to the router fallback instead of on_low_confidence. |
| `shadow` | boolean | ai: decide and log, but deliver through the fallback chain. |
| `budget` | [AIBudget](#aibudget) | ai: when exceeded, the route goes straight to the router fallback. |
| `fallback` | [RouterSpec](#routerspec)[] | Routers tried in order when this one errors, times out, is over budget or (fallback_on_low_confidence) is unsure. |

## `Rule`

| Key | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `when` **(required)** | string | CEL expression over msg (msg.json, msg.headers, msg.subject, msg.source, ...). |
| `to` **(required)** | string[] | Destinations when it holds. |

## `Candidate`

| Key | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `name` **(required)** | string | A declared destination. |
| `description` **(required)** | string | What it is for: the option's criteria. |

## `AIInput`

| Key | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `max_bytes` | [Size](#size) | Cap on the whole state, history included (default 8KiB): oldest turns go first. |
| `redact` | string[] | JSONPaths removed from a JSON state, such as $.card.number. |
| `headers` | string[] | Headers included in the state (allowlist). |

## `Cache`

| Key | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `store` | string | Shared store; default an in-process LRU. |
| `key` | string | Per-message template of the cache key (default: a hash of the state). |
| `ttl` | [Duration](#duration) | Default 10m. |
| `size` | integer | LRU entries (default 10000). |

## `History`

| Key | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `store` | string | Store of the history (default store). |
| `key` **(required)** | string | Per-message template of whose history: customer, conversation, session, device. |
| `window` | [Window](#window) | What is sent to the model. |
| `ttl` **(required)** | [Duration](#duration) | How long records are kept. Mandatory. |
| `record` | [HistoryRecord](#historyrecord) | What is stored. |
| `sticky` | [Sticky](#sticky) | Send follow-ups where the previous call went. |
| `on_store_error` | string | ignore (default): route without history; fallback: use router.fallback. One of `ignore`, `fallback`. |

## `Window`

| Key | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `max_entries` | integer | Newest records sent (default 10). |
| `max_age` | [Duration](#duration) | Oldest record sent. |

## `HistoryRecord`

| Key | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `state` | string | redacted (default): the redacted state; summary: the summary template; none: only decision and outcome. One of `redacted`, `summary`, `none`. |
| `summary` | string | Per-message template of the summary, such as {{ .json.type }} / {{ .json.subject }}. |

## `Sticky`

| Key | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | boolean | Turn sticky routing on. |
| `mode` | string | model (default): ask the model whether it is a follow-up; always_last: always reuse the last destinations, no model call. One of `model`, `always_last`, `off`. |
| `follow_up_threshold` | number | Follow-up probability needed (default 0.8). |

## `AIBudget`

| Key | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `max_calls_per_minute` | integer | Model calls per minute. |
| `max_tokens_per_hour` | integer | Model tokens per hour. |
| `store` | string | Store that shares the counters across replicas (default: in-process). |

## `Transform`

| Key | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `filter` | string | CEL expression; false drops the message from this route or destination. |
| `jq` | string | jq program over the JSON body; its output is the new body. |
| `template` | string | Go template rendered as the new body. |
| `headers` | [HeaderOps](#headerops) | Set, add or remove headers (values are templates). |
| `codec` | string | Re-encode the body. One of `json`, `text`, `base64_encode`, `base64_decode`, `form_to_json`, `cloudevents`. |
| `content_type` | string | Set the content type (alone, or after jq or template). |
| `redact` | string[] | JSONPaths whose values are replaced with [redacted] in the JSON body, such as $.card.number or $..email. |
| `validate` | [SchemaCheck](#schemacheck) | Check the JSON body against a JSON Schema; a body that does not match is a failure. |

## `HeaderOps`

| Key | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `set` | map of string | Replace. |
| `add` | map of string | Append. |
| `remove` | string[] | Delete. |

## `Store`

| Key | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `name` **(required)** | string | Unique store name. |
| `type` **(required)** | string | redis, or memory (in-process: local runs and tests). One of `redis`, `memory`. |
| `addr` | string | redis standalone: host:port. |
| `sentinel` | [Sentinel](#sentinel) | redis Sentinel. |
| `cluster` | [Cluster](#cluster) | redis Cluster. |
| `username` | string | ACL user. |
| `password` | string | Password, usually {{secrets.NAME}}. |
| `tls` | [TLS](#tls) | TLS to Redis. |
| `db` | integer | Database number (standalone and Sentinel). |
| `key_prefix` | string | Key prefix (default hikyaku). |
| `timeout` | [Duration](#duration) | Per-operation timeout (default 50ms): reads must never stall routing. |
| `retry` | [Retry](#retry) | Retries per operation (default attempts 2, backoff 10ms). |
| `circuit_breaker` | [CircuitBreaker](#circuitbreaker) | Stops hammering a dead store (default on). |

## `DeadLetter`

| Key | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `type` **(required)** | string | Protocol: http, https, ws, wss, sse, stdout, stderr, file, fault, group, grpc, tcp, udp, kafka, nats, jetstream, mqtt, amqp, redis, sqs, sns, eventbridge, s3, pubsub, gcs, servicebus, eventhubs, model, or a plugin's type. |
| `url` | string | http/ws: target URL, which may contain per-message templates (hosts are checked against egress). grpc: grpc://host:port or grpcs://; tcp: tcp://host:port or tls://; udp: udp://host:port or dtls://; nats, mqtt, amqp, redis: the server URL. |
| `method` | string | http: method (default POST); grpc: full method name, /package.Service/Method. |
| `headers` | map of string | Headers set on every request; values may be per-message templates. |
| `body` | string | Per-message template of the outgoing body (default: the message body). |
| `tls` | [TLS](#tls) | Client TLS, DTLS for udp (mTLS with cert_file and key_file). |
| `sign` | [Sign](#sign) | http: sign every request with an HMAC of its body, so the receiver can check who sent it. |
| `path` | string | file: the file appended to; sse: the stream path (default /). |
| `listen` | string | sse: address the event stream is served on. |
| `format` | string | file/stdout/stderr: write each message as an envelope line (default) or its body. One of `envelope`, `body`. |
| `frame` | string | ws: frame type, text (default) or binary. tcp, udp: framing, newline (default), length (a length_bytes big-endian prefix) or raw. One of `text`, `binary`, `newline`, `length`, `raw`. |
| `event` | string | sse: per-message template of the event name. |
| `replay` | integer | sse: events kept for Last-Event-ID resume (default 1000). |
| `auth` | [Auth](#auth) | sse: authentication of the clients that read the stream: bearer, api_key, jwt, ip_allow (401 on failure; hmac does not apply). |
| `fault` | [Fault](#fault) | fault: the faults injected (local testing and the resilience suite). |
| `brokers` | string[] | kafka: bootstrap brokers (host:port). |
| `topic` | string | Per-message template of the topic. kafka, mqtt, pubsub: the topic; sns: the topic ARN; eventhubs: the event hub; servicebus: the topic. |
| `key` | string | Per-message template of the message key. kafka: record key (partitioning); pubsub: ordering key; eventhubs: partition key; s3, gcs: object key (default <relay>/<date>/<id>.json, or .ndjson for a batch). |
| `sasl` | [SASL](#sasl) | kafka: SASL authentication. |
| `username` | string | mqtt, nats, redis, amqp: user name. |
| `password` | string | mqtt, nats, redis, amqp: password; use {{secrets.X}}. |
| `token` | string | nats: authentication token; use {{secrets.X}}. |
| `creds_file` | string | nats: a .creds file (JWT and NKey seed). |
| `subject` | string | Per-message template of the subject. nats, jetstream: the subject published to; sns: the message subject. |
| `acks` | string | kafka: acknowledgements a produce waits for (default all, with the idempotent producer). One of `all`, `leader`, `none`. |
| `compression` | string | kafka: batch compression (default none). One of `none`, `gzip`, `snappy`, `lz4`, `zstd`. |
| `qos` | integer | mqtt: publish QoS (default 1). One of `0`, `1`, `2`. |
| `retain` | boolean | mqtt: publish retained messages. |
| `client_id` | string | mqtt: client identifier; kafka: client.id. Default hikyaku-<relay>-<destination>. |
| `protocol_version` | string | mqtt: protocol version (default 5). One of `3.1.1`, `5`. |
| `exchange` | string | amqp: exchange published to (default the default exchange, which routes by queue name). |
| `routing_key` | string | amqp: per-message template of the routing key. |
| `persistent` | boolean | amqp: persistent delivery mode (default true). |
| `mandatory` | boolean | amqp: fail a message no queue is bound to receive (a permanent error) instead of dropping it. |
| `declare` | boolean | amqp: declare the exchange (topic, durable) when missing. |
| `stream` | string | redis: stream key appended to (XADD); jetstream: the stream a publish must land in (an expected-stream check). |
| `channel` | string | redis: pub/sub channel published to; a per-message template. |
| `max_len` | integer | redis streams: approximate length the stream is trimmed to (MAXLEN ~). |
| `descriptor_set` | string | grpc: a FileDescriptorSet file describing method's service. |
| `reflection` | boolean | grpc: resolve method through server reflection when there is no descriptor_set (default true). |
| `length_bytes` | integer | tcp, udp: size of the length prefix with frame: length (default 4). One of `1`, `2`, `4`, `8`. |
| `queue_url` | string | sqs: the queue URL. |
| `group_id` | string | Per-message template of the ordering group. sqs, sns FIFO: message group ID; servicebus: session ID. |
| `delay` | [Duration](#duration) | sqs: delivery delay (at most 15m). |
| `event_bus` | string | eventbridge: event bus name or ARN (default the account's default bus). |
| `event_source` | string | eventbridge: the events' source field (default hikyaku.<relay>). |
| `detail_type` | string | eventbridge: per-message template of the detail-type (default the message subject, else hikyaku.message). |
| `bucket` | string | s3, gcs: the bucket written to. |
| `content_type` | string | s3, gcs: the objects' content type (default the message's). |
| `queue` | string | servicebus: the queue (or topic). |
| `aws` | [AWS](#aws) | sqs, sns, eventbridge, s3: AWS region and credentials (default the SDK's chain). |
| `gcp` | [GCP](#gcp) | pubsub, gcs: project and credentials (default Application Default Credentials). |
| `azure` | [Azure](#azure) | servicebus, eventhubs: connection string or namespace and credentials. |
| `model` | string | model: the Genkit model that answers, provider/name (googleai/gemini-2.5-flash, openai/gpt-4o-mini, openrouter/anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.5, ollama/llama3.2). |
| `generation` | [Generation](#generation) | model: generation settings applied when the request does not set them. |
| `options` | object | Settings of a plugin type (a destination registered by a custom build); the plugin decodes and validates them. |
| `retry` | [Retry](#retry) | Retries of a DLQ write (default attempts 3). |
| `fallback` | string[] | Tried in order when the DLQ fails: destination names, or stdout / stderr. A message is acked only once some hop has it. |

| Key | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `url` | string | Base URL (default http://localhost:11434). |

## `OnInvalid`

| Key | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `to` **(required)** | string[] | Destinations that get the refused message, with the schema.error attribute set. |

## `OpenAI`

| Key | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `base_url` | string | Base URL of the OpenAI API (default https://api.openai.com/v1, else OPENAI_BASE_URL when set). Point it at any OpenAI-compatible server, such as vLLM, LM Studio, LiteLLM or a gateway; its models are openai/<name>. OPENAI_API_KEY is sent as a bearer token; a server other than the default may need none. |

## `Ordering`

| Key | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `key` | string | Template of the ordering key, such as {{ .json.customer_id }}. Empty: the source's natural order unit (kafka partition, mqtt topic, amqp queue, sqs message group, ...). A constant ("all") orders the whole source. |

## `PluginBinary`

| Key | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `name` **(required)** | string | Plugin name, used in logs and metrics. |
| `command` **(required)** | string | The plugin binary: a path, relative to the spec file, or a name looked up on PATH. |
| `args` | string[] | Arguments passed to the binary. |
| `env` | map of string | Environment variables set for the plugin (values may use {{secrets.X}}). |
| `sha256` | string | Hex SHA-256 of the binary. When set, hikyaku refuses to start a binary that does not match. |

## `RateLimit`

| Key | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `per_second` **(required)** | number | Requests per second, on average (0.5 is one every two seconds). |
| `burst` | integer | Requests that may go out at once after a quiet time (default per_second, rounded up). |

## `Readiness`

| Key | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `destinations` | boolean | Not ready while a required destination can take nothing: every member of it, and of every fallback in its chain, is down (default true). |
| `models` | boolean | Not ready while every model of an AI route's chain fails. A probe calls each model once; /readyz answers from the last probe and refreshes one older than 30s in the background. |

## `Reconnect`

| Key | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `backoff` | [Duration](#duration) | First wait (default 500ms), doubling. |
| `max_backoff` | [Duration](#duration) | Cap (default 30s). |
| `jitter` | string | Default full. One of `full`, `equal`, `none`. |
| `max_attempts` | integer | Give up after this many failed connects in a row; 0 = forever. |

## `Respond`

| Key | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `from` **(required)** | string | Destination whose reply is returned. |
| `timeout` | [Duration](#duration) | How long the caller waits (default 30s); then 504. |

## `SASL`

| Key | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `mechanism` **(required)** | string | SASL mechanism. One of `plain`, `scram-sha-256`, `scram-sha-512`. |
| `username` **(required)** | string | User name. |
| `password` **(required)** | string | Password; use {{secrets.X}}. |

## `SchemaCheck`

| Key | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `schema` | object | The JSON Schema, written inline. |
| `on_invalid` | [OnInvalid](#oninvalid) | On a route: where a body that does not match goes, instead of the dead-letter queue. |
| `file` | string | A JSON Schema file (JSON or YAML), read when the relay starts or reloads. A relative path is relative to the working directory. |

## `Sentinel`

| Key | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `master_name` **(required)** | string | Monitored master. |
| `addrs` **(required)** | string[] | Sentinel addresses. |
| `password` | string | Sentinel password. |

## `Server`

| Key | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `admin` | [Admin](#admin) | Admin API: /healthz /readyz /metrics /reload /v1/feedback /v1/history /v1/tail. |
| `shutdown_grace` | [Duration](#duration) | Time in-flight messages get to finish on shutdown (default 20s). |
| `workers` | integer | Messages processed at once (default 256). |
| `readiness` | [Readiness](#readiness) | What /readyz checks. |

## `Sign`

| Key | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `secret` **(required)** | string | Shared secret, usually {{secrets.NAME}}. |
| `header` | string | Header that carries the signature (default X-Signature-256). |
| `algo` | string | Hash (default sha256). One of `sha256`, `sha512`. |
| `prefix` | string | Text put before the digest, such as sha256=. |
| `encoding` | string | Digest encoding (default hex). One of `hex`, `base64`. |
| `timestamp_header` | string | When set, this header carries the send time in Unix seconds, and the signature covers <timestamp>.<body>, so a receiver can refuse an old request. |

## `SystemOne`

| Key | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `servers` | string[] | Known servers: typesafe (TYPESAFE_API_KEY), openrouter (OPENROUTER_API_KEY), workersai (CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN), ollama (no key). |
| `custom` | [SystemOneServer](#systemoneserver)[] | Any other server that speaks the System One protocol. |
| `workersai_account_id` | string | Cloudflare account ID for workersai (else CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID). |
| `ollama_url` | string | Base URL of the Ollama decision server (default http://localhost:11434). |
| `typesafe_base_url` | string | Override TypeSafe's base URL (else TYPESAFE_BASE_URL). |
| `openrouter_base_url` | string | Override OpenRouter's base URL. |

## `SystemOneServer`

| Key | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `provider` **(required)** | string | Plugin name and model prefix: models are <provider>/<id>. |
| `base_url` **(required)** | string | Server root. |
| `path` | string | Decision endpoint path (default /v1/systemone). |
| `models_path` | string | Model listing path. |
| `api_key` | string | Bearer key, usually {{secrets.NAME}}. |
| `headers` | map of string | Extra request headers. |
| `images` | boolean | The server reads images. |

## `TLS`

| Key | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | boolean | Use TLS (implied by any other field and by https/wss). |
| `cert_file` | string | Certificate (server cert, or client cert for mTLS). |
| `key_file` | string | Private key of cert_file. |
| `ca_file` | string | CA bundle that verifies the server. |
| `client_ca_file` | string | listen: CA bundle that verifies client certificates (mTLS). |
| `server_name` | string | SNI and verification name. |
| `insecure_skip_verify` | boolean | Skip server verification (development only). |

## Scalar types

### `Duration`

A duration: 500ms, 30s, 5m, 1h, 7d.

### `Percent`

A share: 50% or 0.5.

### `Size`

A byte count: 512, 8KiB, 10MB.

### `TagList`

Error tags: classes (connect, timeout), ranges (5xx, 4xx), exact codes (503, or a bare number) and protocol codes (ws:close_1011).
